<a id="demolock"></a>

## `DemoLock`

static class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.DemoLock` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader`

RP-2. Reads the running game's facts once, asks [`DemoLockPolicy`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.md#demolockpolicy) whether the loader may run, and keeps the answer for every plugin. Each CWY plugin's `Awake` returns before it patches or loads anything when [`DemoLock.IsLocked`](#demolock--islocked) is true; [`ModLoaderPlugin`](#modloaderplugin) calls `DemoLock.Engage` first, which also logs the verdict and puts the message on screen.

<a id="demolock--islocked"></a>

### `static bool IsLocked { get; }`

True when the loader must not run (the demo, or another Steam app).

<a id="demolock--verdict"></a>

### `static DemoLockVerdict Verdict { get; }`

The verdict, read on first use.

<a id="modloaderpaths"></a>

## `ModLoaderPaths`

static class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.ModLoaderPaths` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader`

The directories the framework owns. Resolved from BepInEx's own path table rather than from anything hard-coded, so the same DLL works on macOS and Windows, and named here once so that no plugin builds its own `Path.Combine(BepInExRootPath, …)` and drifts.

<a id="modloaderpaths--backupsroot"></a>

### `static string BackupsRoot { get; }`

Launch save backups, next to the game's own save folder: &lt;Application.persistentDataPath&gt;/CWYLS Backups (macOS `~/Library/Application Support/nestopi/Chill With You`, Windows `%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\nestopi\Chill With You`). Outside the game folder, so uninstalling or reinstalling the game in Steam leaves them alone, and outside `SaveData`, the folder Steam Cloud syncs. Created by the backup feature when it first makes one, not by [`ModLoaderPaths.EnsureCreated`](#modloaderpaths--ensurecreated).

<a id="modloaderpaths--dataroot"></a>

### `static string DataRoot { get; }`

Everything the framework writes for out-of-process readers: &lt;BepInEx&gt;/data. The game data bus writes `snapshot.json` here, and the loader smoke checks use a `_smoke` scratch folder inside it.

<a id="modloaderpaths--packsroot"></a>

### `static string PacksRoot { get; }`

Content packs live beside the game, not inside BepInEx: &lt;game root&gt;/CWYLS Mods.

<a id="modloaderpaths--traceroot"></a>

### `static string TraceRoot { get; }`

Trace/JSONL output of the game trace: &lt;BepInEx&gt;/trace.

<a id="modloaderpaths--ensurecreated"></a>

### `static void EnsureCreated()`

Creates all three directories if they are missing. Idempotent.

<a id="modloaderplugin"></a>

## `ModLoaderPlugin`

class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.ModLoaderPlugin` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader`

Base: `BaseUnityPlugin`

Entry point of the Mod Loader core: identity, logging, the directory layout, the pack scan, and the one smoke runner every plugin's checks are reported through.

This is the assembly's only `BepInPlugin`. The loader checks used to arrive on a second plugin of their own (P1-2 owned `Loaders/` and could not edit this file while other tickets were in it); P1-8 folded them back in, so there is one GUID, one Awake, and one place the `Smoke.*` settings are bound.

<a id="patchtargetregistry"></a>

## `PatchTargetRegistry`

static class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.PatchTargetRegistry` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader`

The one place every adapter and mod declares the game members it depends on. Registration is additive and happens during plugin Awake; the framework verifies the whole table once, so a game update shows up as one readable block in the log instead of as a Harmony failure halfway through a play session.

<a id="patchtargetregistry--all"></a>

### `static IReadOnlyList<PatchTarget> All { get; }`

A snapshot of every registered target, in registration order.

<a id="patchtargetregistry--count"></a>

### `static int Count { get; }`

How many targets are registered.

<a id="patchtargetregistry--owners"></a>

### `static IReadOnlyList<string> Owners { get; }`

A snapshot of the names that have registered a table, in registration order.

<a id="patchtargetregistry--register"></a>

### `static void Register(string owner, IEnumerable<PatchTarget> targets)`

Registers a table. A target whose id is already registered is skipped with a warning rather than replacing the first one: two owners claiming one id is a bug in the tables, and silently letting load order decide the winner would hide it.

**Parameters**

- `owner`: Who is registering, normally the plugin name; used only in logs.
- `targets`: The table to register; null entries are ignored.

**Exceptions**

- `ArgumentException`: `owner` is null or blank.
- `ArgumentNullException`: `targets` is null.

<a id="patchtargetverifier"></a>

## `PatchTargetVerifier`

static class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.PatchTargetVerifier` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader`

Verifies the registered patch targets against the running game and writes the result to the BepInEx log. This is the startup half of the seam check: the framework must say, out loud and once, whether the seams it is built on still exist.

<a id="patchtargetverifier--checkgameversion-gameversiongate-string"></a>

### `static GameVersionCheck CheckGameVersion(GameVersionGate gate, string actualVersion)`

Checks a version against an explicit gate and logs the result.

**Parameters**

- `gate`: The gate to apply.
- `actualVersion`: The running game's version.

**Returns:** The check.

**Exceptions**

- `ArgumentNullException`: `gate` is null.

<a id="patchtargetverifier--checkgameversion-string"></a>

### `static GameVersionCheck CheckGameVersion(string actualVersion)`

Checks the running game's version against [`GameVersionGate.ExpectedGameVersion`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.md#gameversiongate--expectedgameversion) and logs the result: Info on a match, Warning on a mismatch. A mismatch is never fatal - the patch-target report decides whether anything actually broke.

**Parameters**

- `actualVersion`: Normally `UnityEngine.Application.version`.

**Returns:** The check, so a caller can branch on it.

<a id="patchtargetverifier--verifyall"></a>

### `static PatchTargetReport VerifyAll()`

Verifies everything in [`PatchTargetRegistry`](#patchtargetregistry) by reflection.

**Returns:** The report, so a caller can react to [`PatchTargetReport.AllFound`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.md#patchtargetreport--allfound).

<a id="patchtargetverifier--verifyall-ienumerable-patchtarget-imemberresolver"></a>

### `static PatchTargetReport VerifyAll(IEnumerable<PatchTarget> targets, IMemberResolver resolver)`

Verifies an explicit table with an explicit resolver, logging the summary at Info and every missing target at Error.

**Parameters**

- `targets`: The table to verify.
- `resolver`: How to look each target up.

**Returns:** The report.

**Exceptions**

- `ArgumentNullException`: `targets` or `resolver` is null.

## `ReflectionMemberResolver`

sealed class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.ReflectionMemberResolver` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader`

Implements: [`IMemberResolver`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.md#imemberresolver)

Resolves patch targets by reflection over the assemblies loaded into the game process. Everything is looked up by name, so this class - and the whole core - stays free of any reference to Assembly-CSharp: a target may name a type in an assembly we do not link against.

<a id="reflectionmemberresolver--resolve"></a>

### `PatchTargetResult Resolve(PatchTarget target)`

Resolves one target. Implementations must not throw for an absent member.

**Parameters**

- `target`: The target to look up.

**Returns:** A found or missing result, never null.

**Exceptions**

- `ArgumentNullException`: `target` is null.

<a id="typenames"></a>

## `TypeNames`

static class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.TypeNames` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader`

Renders a `Type` as a readable full name. `Type.FullName` is unusable for a closed generic - it spells every argument out assembly-qualified inside double brackets - so generics are rebuilt here in source form before [`PatchSignature.ShortName`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.md#patchsignature--shortname) strips the namespaces.

<a id="typenames--readable"></a>

### `static string Readable(Type type)`

Full name of a type in C#-like form, e.g. `System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<System.String, UnityEngine.AudioClip>`. A nested type keeps the `+` separator that reflection uses, so it round-trips against a [`PatchTarget.ParameterTypeNames`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.md#patchtarget--parametertypenames) entry either way.

**Parameters**

- `type`: The type to render; null renders as `?`.

<a id="typenames--signature-fieldinfo"></a>

### `static string Signature(FieldInfo field)`

Canonical signature of a field as the runtime actually declares it.

**Parameters**

- `field`: The resolved field.

**Exceptions**

- `ArgumentNullException`: `field` is null.

<a id="typenames--signature-methodinfo"></a>

### `static string Signature(MethodInfo method)`

Canonical signature of a method as the runtime actually declares it.

**Parameters**

- `method`: The resolved method.

**Exceptions**

- `ArgumentNullException`: `method` is null.

<a id="typenames--signature-propertyinfo"></a>

### `static string Signature(PropertyInfo property)`

Canonical signature of a property as the runtime actually declares it.

**Exceptions**
